title: 第11章 暗巷
slug: 似锦全本免费-似锦最新章节列表
content_zh:
那是一小截竹管，竹筒口被封住，凭直觉，姜湛认为里面应该装了东西。
他不由倒抽一口冷气，神色紧张盯着姜似。
妹妹该不会瞧上了爱逛青楼的某个贱货吧？这可不行！
姜似细声解释：“碧春楼背后有一条暗巷，二哥留意过没有？”
嘶——四妹连暗巷都知道了？莫非已经和那贱货约过会了？
姜湛神色越发难看了。
那条暗巷鲜少有人踏足，据说碧春楼里年老色衰的妓子病死后会裹着草席从那里悄悄运走。
他还是无意中瞧见有人把一名从碧春楼里出来的醉汉拖到那条暗巷里暴揍，才留意到有这么一条巷子。
“二哥不知道啊？既然这样，那我——”
“知道，知道！”
“那就请二哥带着竹筒去那条暗巷里仔细找一下，那里应该设有“蔽竹”。
所谓蔽竹，是长尺许的圆筒，一般设在偏僻的巷子中，若是有人想要检举某些官员的恶行，就可以悄悄把信笺投进去，自有暗设蔽竹的御史定时来取。
前一世安国公府把此事死死瞒了下来，伯府有祖母压着亦没有传出风声去，自然没有御史找安国公府麻烦。
眼下安国公府的闹剧虽然传开了，但都察院的御史们天还黑着就上朝去了，此时还没听到风声。等再过几日事情淡了，即便有御史耳闻，也不见得愿意找安国公府的麻烦。
这一次，姜似才不想让安国公府那么好过。
都察院中有位姓牛的御史，是出了名的软硬不吃，今日退朝后就会派亲信去取他专设于碧春楼暗巷的蔽竹。她请兄长帮忙，便是想在最快的时间让牛御史狠狠咬安国公府一口。
她知道此事并不奇怪，前世牛御史取到蔽竹后大笔一挥就把礼部尚书给弹劾了。
礼部尚书是当朝太子妃的祖父，结果后来证明是诬告，于是被罢官免职。
可怜牛御史是个烈性的，竟触柱身亡。然而牛御史一死，生前得罪的人又多，剩下一家子孤儿寡母的下场就可想而知了。
直到太子犯事被废，有人设计牛御史的事才被人捅了出来，然而悲剧已经无法挽回。

姜似想，以牛御史的急性子，应该很乐意把安国公府的闹剧讲给皇上听的。
只要季崇易与女子殉情的事被皇上知道，季三公子想要再娶名门闺秀就是奢望，到最后说不定会与巧娘有情人终成眷属，就别祸害别人家姑娘了。
既能救牛御史性命，又能成全一对有情人，姜似觉得自己怪善解人意的。
“蔽竹是什么？”姜湛一脸茫然。
姜似看着兄长，叹了口气。
还是熟悉的配方，还是熟悉的味道，她的哥哥还是这么不学无术！
把“蔽竹”是什么解释清楚，姜湛一脸兴奋：“居然还有这么有意思的玩意儿，早知道我也写封信试试了。”
“二哥还是不要乱来，那些揭发人恶行的信被很多人视为洪水猛兽，要是流传出去被人瞧出字迹会惹麻烦的。”
“这样啊。”姜湛遗憾摇头。
“二哥快些去吧，不然没等御史弹劾安国公府，祖母就把二叔叫回来了。府中大事自来就是祖母与二叔两个人拿主意，我想二叔定然不乐意我退亲。”
“妹妹放心，我这就去，绝不误了你的事！”
“二哥带上这双木箸，记得把蔽竹里最上面的一个小竹筒夹出来。”
最上面那个小竹筒里放的就是检举礼部尚书的信笺。
“为何？”
“以后我再给二哥解释，现在来不及了。”
姜似一催促，姜湛立刻忘了好奇，把小竹筒往怀里一塞，匆忙走了。
姜似忍不住笑了。
兄长这样也挺好，好奇心再强，转头就忘了。
姜湛怀揣着竹筒，片刻不敢耽误赶去碧春楼。
没办法，谁让他轻车熟路呢。

早上的碧春楼是最安静的，大门紧闭，屋檐下挂着的大红灯笼早已熄灭，随风微微晃动着，显得没精打采。
白日正是楼里人补眠的时候，到了华灯初上，整座碧春楼流光溢彩，才会重新热闹起来。
姜湛按着姜似所说钻进那条暗巷，果然在某青砖斑驳之处寻到了蔽竹。
先用木箸从蔽竹开口处夹出一个小竹筒，再把带来的竹筒塞进去，完成任务的姜湛本该功成身退，可他眼珠一转，爬上了墙根一棵大树。
正值夏日，大树枝叶繁茂，把他的身形遮挡得严严实实。

content_en:
It was a small bamboo tube, and the mouth of the bamboo tube was sealed. Based on intuition, Jiang Zhan thought there should be something inside.
He couldn't help but gasp and stared at Jiang Si nervously.
Could it be that my sister has fallen in love with some bitch who likes visiting brothels? This is not possible!
Jiang Si explained in a soft voice: "There is a dark alley behind Bichun Tower. Have you noticed it?"
Hiss - the fourth sister even knows about the dark alley? Could it be that you have already dated that bitch?
Jiang Zhan's expression became increasingly ugly.
That dark alley is rarely visited by people. It is said that the old and lustful prostitutes in Bichun Tower will be quietly transported away from there wrapped in straw mats after they die of illness.
He accidentally saw someone dragging a drunkard who came out of Bichun Building into the dark alley and beat him up, and that's when he noticed the existence of such an alley.
"Second brother doesn't know? In that case, then I -"
"I know, I know!"
"Then ask the second brother to take the bamboo tube to the dark alley and search carefully. There should be a "shielding bamboo" there.
The so-called shielding bamboo is a cylinder about a foot long, usually placed in a remote alley. If someone wants to report the evil deeds of certain officials, they can secretly put a letter into it, and the censor who has hidden the shielding bamboo will come to pick it up at regular intervals.
In the previous life, An Guo Gong's Mansion kept this matter secret. The uncle's grandmother suppressed it and no news spread. Naturally, there was no censor to trouble An Guo Gong's Mansion.
Although the farce in Duke An's mansion has spread, the censors of the Metropolitan Procuratorate went to court while it was still dark and have not yet heard the news. When the matter calms down in a few days, even if the imperial censor hears about it, he may not be willing to cause trouble for Anguo Gongfu.
This time, Jiang Sixicai didn't want to make life so easy for Duke An Guo.
There is a censor surnamed Niu in the Metropolitan Procuratorate, who is famous for not taking soft and hard advice. After he retires from the court today, he will send his cronies to pick up the bamboo screen he specially set up in the dark alley of Bichun Tower. She asked her brother for help because she wanted Niu Yushi to bite Anguo Gong's house hard as soon as possible.
It's not surprising that she knew this. In the previous life, Censor Niu impeached the Minister of Rites after getting the bamboo with a stroke of his pen.
The Minister of Rites was the grandfather of the current crown prince, but it turned out to be a false accusation and he was dismissed from office.
Poor Niu Yushi was a fierce man, so he hit the pillar and died. However, once Niu Yushi died, he offended many people during his lifetime, and one can imagine the fate of the family left with an orphan and a widowed mother.
It wasn't until the prince committed a crime and was deposed that someone was involved in plotting against Niu Yushi. However, the tragedy was irreversible.
Jiang Si thought that with Niu Yushi's impatience, he would be happy to tell the emperor about the farce in Anguo Palace.
As long as the emperor knew about Ji Chongyi's death in love with the woman, it would be an extravagant hope for Mr. Ji San to marry a famous lady. In the end, he might end up getting married to Qiao Niang, so he shouldn't harm other girls.
Not only could he save Niu Yushi's life, but he could also marry a pair of lovers. Jiang Si felt that he was very considerate.
"What is Bamboo? "Jiang Zhan looked confused.
Jiang Si looked at his brother and sighed.
It's still a familiar recipe, it's still a familiar taste, and her brother is still so ignorant!
After explaining clearly what "Shielding Bamboo" was, Jiang Zhan looked excited: "There is such an interesting thing. If I had known, I would have written a letter and tried it. "
"Second brother, please don't mess around. Those letters that expose people's evil deeds are regarded as a scourge by many people. If they are circulated and someone sees the handwriting, they will get into trouble. "
"That's it. "Jiang Zhan shook his head regretfully.
"Second brother, please go quickly, otherwise my grandmother will call my second uncle back before the censor can impeach Duke Anguo. Grandma and my second uncle have always made the decision on major affairs in the house. I think my second uncle would not be happy for me to break off the engagement. "
“Don’t worry, sister, I’ll go right away and I won’t miss your business! "
"Second brother, take this pair of wooden chopsticks and remember to take out the top small bamboo tube in the bamboo cover. "
The small bamboo tube at the top contains the letter of report against the Minister of Rites.
"Why? "
"afterI'll explain to my second brother again, but it's too late now. "
As soon as Jiang Si urged, Jiang Zhan immediately forgot his curiosity, stuffed the small bamboo tube into his arms, and left in a hurry.
Jiang Si couldn't help but laugh.
It's good for my brother to be like this. No matter how curious he is, he will forget about it.
Jiang Zhan held the bamboo tube in his arms and rushed to Bichun Tower without any delay.
There is no way, who makes him familiar with the road.
Bichun Tower is the quietest in the morning. The door is closed and the red lanterns hanging under the eaves have long been extinguished. They are swaying slightly in the wind, looking listless.
During the day, people in the building are catching up on their sleep. When the lanterns come on, the whole Bichun Building is filled with light and becomes lively again.
Jiang Zhan followed Jiang Si's instructions and went into the dark alley, and sure enough he found a bamboo shield in a spot with mottled green bricks.
First, he used wooden chopsticks to pinch out a small bamboo tube from the opening of the bamboo shield, and then stuffed the bamboo tube he brought in. After completing the task, Jiang Zhan should have retired, but he rolled his eyes and climbed up a big tree at the base of the wall.
It was summer, and the large branches were thickly covered with leaves, completely blocking his figure.
